data.name: ModelNote
data.value: Simplified estimate with 45-minute absorption and a 5-hour half-life. This does not measure sleep quality.

data.name: NoFavorites
data.value: Save your usual portion as a favorite when logging a drink.

data.name: SaveFavorite
data.value: Save this drink and portion as a favorite

data.name: NoLogs
data.value: No drinks logged for this day.

data.name: AverageNote
data.value: The average includes elapsed days of the week, including today. An empty day means 0 mg logged, not a confirmed caffeine-free day.

data.name: InvalidConsumptionTime
data.value: Consumption must be between 2000-01-01 and now.

data.name: InvalidCustomDrink
data.value: Enter the drink name and caffeine content.

data.name: ManufacturerValue
data.value: Manufacturer value; check the variant on the label

data.name: PreparationEstimate
data.value: Estimate; varies by preparation and variant

data.name: StreakTodayPending
data.value: Today is still open. Keep your streak going before midnight.

data.name: StreakExplanation
data.value: Log a drink or mark a caffeine-free day. You do not need to consume caffeine to keep your streak.

data.name: CaffeineFreeSaved
data.value: Today is marked caffeine-free. Logging caffeine later automatically clears this marker.

data.name: CaffeineFreeBlocked
data.value: You have logged caffeine today, so this day cannot be marked caffeine-free.

data.name: StreakDayChanged
data.value: The submitted date is not today. Check the date and try again.

data.name: InvalidInput
data.value: Check required fields, dates and allowed values.

data.name: InvalidSleep
data.value: Waking must follow bedtime within 24 hours. Future sleep cannot be logged.

data.name: SleepDuplicate
data.value: You already have an entry for this waking date. Open it to edit.

data.name: SleepDateNote
data.value: Sleep belongs to the date you woke up. Overnight and daytime sleep are supported.

data.name: SleepSnapshotNote
data.value: Caffeine data is linked automatically as a snapshot. Later drink edits update it only when you save this sleep entry again. Duration is the difference between the local times entered.

data.name: PreviousDayCaffeine
data.value: Total caffeine on the previous calendar day

data.name: ImportedSleepCopy
data.value: Imported guest entry for a date already logged. It is preserved, but only the original account entry counts towards trends.

data.name: SleepInsightNote
data.value: We examine the latest 90 logged nights, with at least 10 usable entries per measure. These are associations in your diary, not medical or causal conclusions. Other factors may affect sleep.

data.name: LateCaffeineVsDifficulty
data.value: Caffeine closer to bedtime → difficulty falling asleep

data.name: InsufficientSleepData
data.value: There is not enough data for a personal trend yet. At least 10 usable nights are needed.

data.name: SleepNoVariation
data.value: The logged values are too similar to show a meaningful comparison.

data.name: SleepLowerAssociation
data.value: In your diary, higher values of the first measure tended to accompany lower values of the second.

data.name: SleepHigherAssociation
data.value: In your diary, higher values of the first measure tended to accompany higher values of the second.

data.name: SleepNoClearAssociation
data.value: Your diary currently shows no clear linear association between these two measures.

data.name: PersonalTargetNote
data.value: A personal setting, not a health threshold. Caffeine levels are estimates; individual elimination can differ.

data.name: PersonalThresholdEstimate
data.value: Estimated time below your personal {0} mg target:

data.name: WhatIfNote
data.value: Try a drink or caffeine dose without logging it. Calculations also include your logged caffeine.

data.name: ManualDoseNote
data.value: When a drink is selected, its caffeine content and volume are used. A custom dose is used only without a selected drink.

data.name: ExistingAtBedtime
data.value: At bedtime without the hypothetical drink

data.name: NoCutoff
data.value: No suitable time within the calculation range with your current diary.

data.name: AfterCutoff
data.value: The hypothetical intake time is after the estimated cutoff.

data.name: CutoffNote
data.value: The estimate is for a dose in addition to logged drinks. It uses the post-absorption phase; a low initial estimate does not suggest drinking right before sleep.

data.name: UnderTargetAt
data.value: Estimated time below target, after absorption

data.name: WhatIfCurve
data.value: Estimated caffeine curve with and without the drink

data.name: ConfirmLoggingNote
data.value: This opens the logging form. Only submitting that form saves data; future intake cannot be logged.

data.name: InvalidPlanningTime
data.value: Choose an intake time now or within 2 days, followed by bedtime within 3 days.

data.name: LifetimeAverageNote
data.value: The lifetime average includes every calendar day since the first drink/marked day. The 7/30-day averages always divide by 7/30, including today so far. Tracking since:

data.name: HighestIntakeNote
data.value: A descriptive value, not a goal. Average times use local clock times on days with caffeine.

data.name: HeatmapNote
data.value: Daily caffeine intake. Scroll horizontally and tap a day to open its diary.

data.name: HeatmapLegend
data.value: Shades: 0 / 1–100 / 101–200 / 201–400 / over 400 mg. Outline: marked caffeine-free day. A lighter shade does not mean a better result.

data.name: ResetGenericResponse

data.name: PasswordResetComplete
data.value: Your password has changed. Sign in with the new password; previous sessions have been invalidated.

data.name: InvalidResetToken
data.value: The link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link.

data.name: NotificationNote
data.value: Each notification type is optional. After saving your choices, enable browser notifications separately on this device.

data.name: NotificationTimeNote
data.value: Times use the configured tracker timezone. Cutoff uses this dose, saved bedtime and target. Delivery may be delayed or missed; the server must be running.

data.name: IosPushNote
data.value: On iPhone/iPad, add Koffi to the Home Screen, open it there, then tap enable. Notification text may appear on your lock screen.

data.value: Push delivery is not enabled on this installation yet.

data.value: Device connected. Notifications follow your saved preferences.

data.value: This browser or launch mode does not support push. On iOS, use the Home Screen app.

data.name: DisableAllConfirm

data.name: PushSleep
